chunks: If God had pleased He would have made them one community of belief; but He admits whom He please to His grace; yet the sinners have neither friend nor helper.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of God making people one community in Surah Ash-Shura?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine wisdom behind religious diversity, distinguishing between the natural plurality of creation and the specific mercy granted to the righteous. It highlights that while God could have enforced uniformity, He chose to allow varied paths to faith, reserving ultimate mercy for those who respond to His call, while the unjust remain devoid of divine support.
